summary.text: Howard Otto Wachsmann, Jr. is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 83rd District, which covers Brunswick County, part of Dinwiddie County, Greensville County, part of Isle of Wight County, Southampton County, Sussex County and the city of Emporia, and has served since 2022.
Wachsmann sits on the House committees on Communications, Technology and Innovation; Privileges and Elections; and Health and Human Services.

paragraphs.text: The profile lists Wachsmann's education as The College of William and Mary; Medical College of Virginia, Virginia Commonwealth University (B.S., Pharmacy, 1986); Shenandoah University (Pharm.D., 2001).

Wachsmann's listed memberships and affiliations include Virginia Pharmacists Association; American Pharmacist Association; Joyner Gray Yale Ruritan Club; National Rifle Association; Virginia Citizens Defense League.
